mapper.insert: INSERT INTO run_event (task_run_id, seq, event_type, payload, occurred_at, created_at) VALUES (#{taskRunId}, #{seq}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSON), #{occurredAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_run_id, seq, event_type, payload, occurred_at, created_at FROM run_event WHERE task_run_id = #{taskRunId} ORDER BY seq
